title: Allow to configure NoUISlider "step" option in rangeSlider widget
body:
I have a dataset where numerical attribute are integers from 1 to 99 so I would like to avoid decimal in the slider's tooltip.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/976175/10615905/b9159cba-7762-11e5-9413-4cee08715956.png)
